title: Finding
description: One observed defect, recorded at the moment of sighting by whoever saw it. Identity is the fingerprint (invariant + verb + normalised path), not the text: the same defect described by a verifier, a reviewer and a stack trace is one finding with three sightings. Never pre-suppress a duplicate — record it and let the store dedupe, because the sighting count is the class signal.

invariant.description: The gate id or charter invariant violated. Gate form: AG-03, SG-02, ET-05, CG-13. Invariant form: INV-06 (four bands), INV-08 (counts computed). UNKNOWN is legal and is itself informative — a defect no gate or invariant names is a gap in the gate set.

path.description: The JSON path, DB column, or file:symbol. NORMALISED: array indices collapsed to [], run ids / entity ids / e_ids / uuids stripped. overview.findings[3].score and overview.findings[11].score are one path.

locus.description: Where in the pipeline the defect lives — not where it was noticed. A field discarded at promotion has locus=promote even though it was seen on a rendered card.

verb.description: What went wrong. With invariant and path this is the fingerprint. Same invariant + same verb + same path = recurrence; same invariant + same verb + different path = one class.

observed.description: What actually happened, in the source's own words. Not a paraphrase — the detail dropped in paraphrase is usually the fingerprint.

source.description: Which producer sighted it. Provenance, in the same sense a payload cites evidence.

session_ref.description: The session, run or CI job the sighting came from. What makes a finding re-readable across sessions.

run_id.description: The assessment run, where the sighting had one.

entity_id.description: The entity. Carries client identity: treat as internal.

surface.description: Page and section, e.g. overview.findings, heatmap.cell_evidence.

severity.description: probed_clean records an attack that came up empty. Recorded deliberately: silence about an attack never run reads identically to one that passed.

client_reach.description: How far it got. 'rendered' forces rung >= R3 by the ladder's second rule.

excerpt.description: Verbatim from the artefact — the verdict line, the failing assertion, the card text, the auditor row. A finding summarised out of its source cannot be re-read.

artefact_ref.description: Path or URL the excerpt came from.

would_have_caught_it.description: One sentence: the check that was missing. A hypothesis, allowed to be wrong. Three sightings later it is what makes the cluster's rung obvious.

r_layer.description: For a reviewer rejection: the card's recorded reasoning. REJECT against verdict=ACCEPT means the probe set lacks the probe the human just ran; REJECT against an absent r_layer is AG-family gate territory.

internal_only.description: JSON paths within this finding that must not leave an internal audience — reviewer notes, card bodies, entity identity. Annotations are refused for the customer audience; redaction does not stop at the serving layer because the reader is an agent.
